headlines.text: Flames burst from Qantas plane engine after New Zealand takeoff. A terrifying moment unfolded aboard a Qantas flight from Queenstown to Sydney when flames erupted from its left engine.
Yemeni forces claim strategic district amid intensified Houthi clashes. More than 60 people, including civilians, killed as clashes between Yemeni forces and Houthis intensify in Taiz.
Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu says ‘Qatar is a hostile state’. Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu has dismissed accusations about his government’s alleged ties to Qatar as ‘one big bluff’
More than 20 killed in fire at wedding party in DR Congo. Authorities have launched an investigation into a fire that killed 22 people at a wedding party in Kinshasa, DR Congo.
South Africa’s chrome riches fuel a deadly underground economy. Behind South Africa’s chrome riches lies a shadow economy where migrants and unemployed workers face deadly conditions.
German voters head to polls as far-right AfD party eyes historic state win. Saxony-Anhalt elections could see AfD become the first far-right party to take power at a state level since WWII.
Indonesia’s main airport suspends flights due to Anak Krakatau eruption. Volcanic ash from Mount Anak Krakatau disrupts flights at Soekarno-Hatta International airport, near Jakarta.
Nearly 9,000 killed in Israeli attacks on Lebanon since 2023. More than 179 attacks on ambulance crews recorded since March 2, killing 179 healthcare workers.
‘People laughed at me’: Indian youth cleans up a trash-filled river. A 21-year-old student in India’s Madhya Pradesh has single-handedly cleaned up a trash-filled river.
Netanyahu boasts about bombing Qatar, says Gaza funds used for aid. Netanyahu has called Qatar a 'hostile' state and boasted that Israel bombed the country.
German company launches rocket as Europe enters satellite race. Isar Aerospace says its 28-metre-long Spectrum rocket blasted off into space from Andøya spaceport in Arctic Norway.
Iran war live: IRGC claims attacks on 3 oil tankers and 3 US-linked ships. IRGC launches new strikes after firing missiles at US warships as standoff in Strait of Hormuz intensifies.
Fuel tanker blast in western Iran kills at least 10. At least six other people were injured in the tanker blast on Iran's Hamedan-Sanandaj highway, officials say.
Trump-backed group announces $10m ad spend for midterm Senate race in Texas. US president has pledged more than $400m through his super PAC to boost Republican candidates in the upcoming midterms.
US envoys Witkoff, Kushner meet Putin for talks on Ukraine war. US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Kremlin on Saturday.

Michigan Wolverines fend off shocking upset bid from Western Michigan in early season thriller. Michigan football nearly relived its Appalachian State nightmare as Western Michigan led 12-7 before Bryce Underwood's 46-yard Hail Mary saved the day.

California pizza joint allegedly used as meth distribution hub as illegal immigrant charged. Kawal Preet Singh allegedly used a Round Table Pizza in Dinuba to distribute over 40 pounds of methamphetamine as part of an organized crime network.

Kennedy Center ceiling partially collapses as Trump-led board pushes for 2-year closure. Photos show a partial ceiling collapse in a main Kennedy Center hallway, which officials say underscores the urgent need for Trump-backed renovations.

Oregon rallies from slow start, thwarts Boise State's upset bid in season opener. Dante Moore threw for 388 yards and three touchdowns as No. 2 Oregon rallied past Boise State in a tense 34-27 season opener at Autzen Stadium.

Machete-wielding MS-13 gangster wanted for murder walks free after Biden-appointed judge releases him: DHS. A convicted MS-13 killer known as "La Bruja" or "the witch" is free in California after a federal judge ruled ICE held him without a required bond hearing for five months.

Trump-linked MAGA Inc pours $10M into Ken Paxton's Texas Senate race against James Talarico. MAGA Inc. drops $10 million in ads backing Ken Paxton against James Talarico in a neck and neck Texas Senate race that could reshape the midterms.

Tennessee Volunteers fans pay incredible tribute to Dolly Parton during season opener. All 102,000 fans at Neyland Stadium sang Dolly Parton's "I Will Always Love You" in unison as Tennessee football honored the late country icon.

Steelers' Aaron Rodgers hopes to be 'supporting my pregnant wife' by next year after final NFL season. Aaron Rodgers told Mad Dog Sports Radio he hopes to have a pregnant wife by next year as he prepares for life after what may be his final season.

Fan runs onto field at Houston Cougars game, gets absolutely trucked by police officer. A fan who rushed the field during the Houston Cougars’ 33-20 win over the Oregon State Beavers was leveled by a police officer with a textbook tackle.

Dr Phil says Lindsay Clancy mistrial a 'teachable moment' on postpartum psychosis: 'There was a failure here'. Dr. Phil McGraw calls the Lindsay Clancy case a "psychiatric emergency that wasn't treated as such" and warns of a potential copycat effect.

In-N-Out's popular burger style started with a customer request decades ago. In-N-Out's Animal Style burger traces back to the early 1960s, when a customer spotted an associate's custom creation and asked for one just like it.

Somehow, the Miami Hurricanes have done it again with yet another Heisman-level quarterback. Darian Mensah's dominant debut at Miami continues a stunning pattern as Mario Cristobal lands yet another elite transfer portal quarterback.

EXCLUSIVE: FBI's fifth Most Wanted Fraudster captured after alleged SNAP scam suspect arrested in India. Manjit Singh Bedi was arrested in India after allegedly fleeing the U.S. to escape SNAP benefits fraud charges tied to an alleged $600,000 EBT scheme.

Former Pentagon AI chief warns Flock cameras could create 'China-like surveillance state' in the US. Former Pentagon AI Policy Director Mark Beall warns Flock cameras could create a "China-like surveillance state" without strict court oversight.

Bunnie Xo reveals shocking physical toll of divorce from Jelly Roll. Bunnie Xo revealed she lost 20 pounds and needed IVs during her Jelly Roll divorce, detailing the devastating physical toll of her heartbreak.

QUIZ: Ugh, I'll do it later. How much do you know about procrastination?. Learn a few surprising facts about procrastination — and helpful tools to overcome it — with this quiz. It's based on social scientist Itamar Shatz's new book, Solving Procrastination.

Whatever happened to kindness? Spoiler alert: Our readers prove it's alive and well. We asked readers to share stories about a moment of kindness involving a stranger. Here are some of their heartwarming anecdotes.

Jazz legend John Coltrane's Philadelphia house to become a cultural heritage site. On the centennial of father's birth, Ravi Coltrane talks about turning the home where the jazz legend spent a crucial period in the 1950s into a cultural heritage and community space.
U.S. and Iran trade attacks on ships as fighting flares up again
Opinion: A sculpture in perpetual motion, removed. "Blue," a statue that's been on the grounds of the Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C. for 7 years has been dismantled and removed.

Trump administration to dig at triumphal arch site despite no final federal approvals. The Trump administration says it will break ground on a 250-foot triumphal arch in Washington, D.C., without final federal approval and despite an ongoing lawsuit.

U.S.-Venezuela oil deal puts opposition in a political bind. Venezuelan opposition members are uneasy with new oil deals with the U.S., worried that agreements with authoritarian regime in Caracas could undermine democratic progress.

Whatever happened to the floating schools of Bangladesh?. It was a light bulb moment: If monsoon rains keep kids from safely getting to school, let's create a floating school to pick them up! Bangladesh pioneered the idea. How's it doing?

U.S. envoys in Moscow in new push for peace between Russia and Ukraine. U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived in Moscow to revive efforts to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has called for a halt to air attacks during their visit, but Moscow has not publicly responded.

Voters are fed up with data centers. Both parties are trying to cash in for midterms. Democrats and Republicans have found common ground in this campaign season. Both parties have poured millions into ads attacking data centers as the public continues to protest the AI facilities.
